description:
Cast Chain of Plasma targeting Brash Taunter by paying {1}{R}.
Archmage Emeritus triggers, drawing a card.
Resolve Chain of Plasma, dealing 3 damage to Brash Taunter, discarding a card, and copying Chain of Plasma with the same target.
Brash Taunter and Archmage Emeritus trigger.
Resolve Brash Taunter's trigger, dealing 3 damage to target opponent.
Resolve Archamage Emeritus's trigger, drawing a card.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have one card remaining in library, decline to copy Chain of Plasma.
